facts.text: I am trying to decide on a gift for my best friend's birthday.
My best friend's birthday is coming up in 2 weeks.
I want ideas for personalized gifts such as photo albums.
I want ideas for personalized gifts such as customized phone cases.
I want gifts that are sentimental and emotional.
I am drawn to a customized storybook.
I am drawn to a heartfelt letter.
I want tips on how to make a customized storybook or heartfelt letter extra special and personal.
I want ideas for a heartfelt letter.
I want specific things I could say or include in a heartfelt letter to make it really special.
I plan to express gratitude to my friend for being a constant presence in my life.
I plan to share a special memory that highlights my friendship, like a spontaneous road trip we took together.
I plan to acknowledge my friend's importance in my life and how she has helped me grow as a person.
I plan to include funny moments in the letter, like the time we accidentally ordered a ridiculously spicy dish at a restaurant.
I plan to close the letter with a message of love and appreciation.
I plan to express hope for many more years of friendship in the letter.
I am ready to start writing the letter.
I will make sure my writing is sincere and genuine.
I will include specific examples and anecdotes to make the letter personal and relatable.
I will use sensory details to bring the memories to life.
I will express gratitude and appreciation for our friendship.
